page: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by 192.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes 1843 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage configurations, but does not bundle any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates solid performance across standard operations. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512 (specifically AVX-512 Foundation and VNNI), and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. In testing, the instance achieved a Passmark CPU score of 48717.7 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 15064.0. Cryptographic capabilities are notable, with the Passmark CPU encryption test registering a strong score of 43321.1. Memory subsystem performance is also strong, with a Passmark memory score of 2757.12 and a read-only cached small-block memory bandwidth of 2502.0 GB/sec.

While the server demonstrates strong performance in image processing and small-model LLM text generation, it exhibits limitations in large-scale model execution. For instance, LLM text generation using a 70B model drops to a weak 2.74 tokens/sec due to the lack of hardware GPU acceleration. Qualitatively, the D48ds_v5 offers a balanced resource density for general-purpose enterprise workloads, database operations, software compilation, and static web serving, where its 1843 GB local disk and balanced memory-to-core ratio provide cost-efficient execution without the premium of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.
description: The Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine from the DDSv5 family, powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores), 192.0 GB of system memory, and 1843 GB of local storage. Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the server supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AES cryptography. Benchmarks show strong performance in memory operations, encryption, and image processing, alongside average performance in database operations and multi-core processing. However, without GPU acceleration, it exhibits weak performance in large-scale LLM text generation. This instance is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, software compilation, and database workloads requiring local storage.
